book.name: Yoohana
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Yoohana

content: Yɨɨsu nɨ‑mʉzabhiibhu gwa amaheene
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kubhiija, “Inyɨ nɨ‑mʉzabhiibhu gwa amaheene, na Bhaabha waanɨ ni‑murimi.
Ikisha chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ kɨrɨ kwa niinyɨ na kɨtakwibhʉra imisumʉ, Bhaabha arakiruushaho. Nawe ikisha kɨnʉ kikwibhʉra imisumʉ, Bhaabha ahaakɨtagʉrɨra korereke chibhʉrɨ bhʉkʉngʼu.
Imwɨ mʉmarirɨ kʉbhɨngukibhwa, kʉ kʉbha mwisiriiryɨ amiija gaanɨ.

Mʉsaagɨ kwa niinyɨ, na niinyɨ nɨsaagɨ kwa niimwɨ. Chɨmburya ikisha kɨtakʉtʉra kwibhʉra imisumʉ ichene arɨɨbhɨ kɨtakʉsaaga kʉmʉzabhiibhu, ɨbhuɨbhu mʉtakʉtʉra kokora ʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwa Mungu arɨɨbhɨ mʉtasaagirɨ kwa niinyɨ.
“Inyɨ nɨ‑mʉzabhiibhu, na niimwɨ ni‑bhisha. Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉsaaga kwa niinyɨ, na niinyɨ nɨrasaaga kwawɨ, wuyo arabha ariibhʉra imisumʉ myaru, kʉ kʉbha kutiga inyɨ mʉtakʉtʉra kokora ryʉryʉsi.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ atakʉsaaga mʉʉsi waanɨ atuubhɨɨnɨ ni ikisha kɨnʉ kɨkʉtaashwa na kwʉma. Mmbe, abhaatʉ bharaketoora na kʉkɨtaasha momorero, kɨrarʉngʉra.
Arɨɨbhɨ mʉrasaaga mʉʉsi waanɨ na amangʼana gaanɨ garasaaga mʉʉsi waanyu, mʉsabhɨ chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ mukwenda, mʉrahaabhwa.
Arɨɨbhɨ muriibhʉra imisumʉ myaru na kʉbha abhɨɨga bhaanɨ bha amaheene, mʉrabha mʉragʉnga habhwɨrʉ Bhaabha.
Chɨmburya Bhaabha ansɨɨgirɨ inyɨ, nɨmbu na niinyɨ nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ. Mmbe mʉsaagɨ mʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwanɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ mʉragwata amaswaja gaanɨ, mʉrakaja kʉsaaga mʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwanɨ, chɨmburya inyɨ nigwatirɨ ganʉ Bhaabha answajiryɨ na kʉsaaga mʉbhʉsɨɨgi bhwazɨ.
“Nɨbhabhuuriirɨ ganʉ korereke obhozomerwa bhwanɨ bhʉbhɨ mʉʉsi waanyu, no obhozomerwa bhwanyu bhuhikɨ.
Riswaja ryanɨ nɨ‑rɨnʉ, mʉsɨɨganɨ, chɨmburya inyɨ nɨbhasɨɨgirɨ.
Atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ anʉ ʉbhʉsɨɨgi ʉbhʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra wʉnʉ akuhurucha ʉbhʉhʉru bhwazɨ igʉrʉ wa abhasaani bhaazɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ mʉrakora ganʉ nɨbhaswajiryɨ, imwɨ nɨ‑bhasaani bhaanɨ.

Kwɨma nangwɨnʉ, nɨtakʉbha nɨrabhabhɨrɨkɨra naatu abhahocha bhaanɨ, kʉ kʉbha omohocha atɨɨzɨ kɨnʉ ʉmʉkʉrʉ waazɨ akokora. Nawe imwɨ nɨbhahumburiirɨ gʉʉsi ganʉ niigwirɨ kurwa kwa Bhaabha, mmbe ɨbhu nɨrabha nɨrabhabhɨrɨkɨra abhasaani bhaanɨ.

Imwɨ mʉkɨɨrɨ kondobhora inyɨ, nawe niinyɨ nɨbharʉbhwɨrɨ imwɨ. Nɨkabharobhora korereke mujɨ mwibhʉrɨ imisumʉ gɨnʉ gɨtakusira. Moreekorebhu, gʉʉsi ganʉ mʉkʉsabha kʉhɨtɨra kuriina ryanɨ, Bhaabha arabhaha.
Mmbe, riswaja ryanɨ kwa niimwɨ nɨ rɨnʉ, mʉsɨɨganɨ.”
Abhaatʉ bha kʉʉsɨ bharabhiihirirwa bhanʉ bhakwisirirya Yɨɨsu
Yɨɨsu akangʼeha kubhiija, “Arɨɨbhɨ abhaatʉ bha kʉʉsɨ bharaabhabhiihirirwɨ, mʉbhɨ mʉrahiita kʉbha bhakakangata kumbiihirirwa inyɨ.

Mwangabhɨɨrɨ abhaatʉ bha kʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ, bhayo bhaarɨ bharabhasɨɨga chɨmburya bhabhasɨɨgirɨ abhaatʉ bhaabhʉ. Nawe kʉ kʉbha imwɨ mʉtarɨ bha kʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ na nɨbharʉbhwɨrɨ kurwa kʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ, igʉrʉ wa riyo, abhaatʉ bha kʉʉsɨ bharabhabhiihirirwa.

Muhiitɨ ganʉ nabhabhuuriirɨ, ‘Mbʉʉsa atarɨ mʉkʉrʉ kʉkɨra umuniibhi waazɨ.’ Mmbe, arɨɨbhɨ bhakanyaacha inyɨ, bharabhanyaacha na niimwɨ kwikɨ. Nawe arɨɨbhɨ bhakiisirirya amiija gaanɨ, bhariisirirya na agaanyu.
Nawe bharabhakorera gʉʉsi gayo kʉ kʉbha mʉrantuna inyɨ, na kʉ kʉbha bhatɨɨzɨ wʉnʉ antumirɨ.
Arɨɨbhɨ nangatamirɨ kuuza kwebho na kʉgamba nabhʉ, mmbe bhataarɨ bharabha nʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ. Nawe nangʉ, bhatakʉtʉra kwibhagɨra kʉbha bhataana ʉbhʉbhɨ.
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akumbiihirirwa inyɨ, wʉʉsi arabhiihirirwa na Bhaabha waanɨ.

Nɨkʉrirɨ ɨbhɨsɨgʉ ɨbhɨkʉrʉ bhɨnʉ ʉwʉndɨ akɨɨrɨ kokora. Angabhɨɨrɨ bhatabhɨrʉʉzɨ, bhangabhɨɨrɨ bhataana ʉbhʉbhɨ. Nawe nangʉ, bharʉʉzɨ ganʉ gʉʉsi nakʉrirɨ, bhakɨɨrɨ bhambiihiriirwɨ na bhabhiihiriirwɨ Bhaabha.
Nawe ganʉ gakʉrirwɨ korereke kuhicha amangʼana ganʉ gaandikirwɨ mʉMaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu kʉbha, ‘Bhakambiihirirwa bhʉʉha.’
“Nɨratʉma kwa niimwɨ Ʉmʉsakirya, ʉmʉsakirya wuyo ne‑Koro Ɨndɨndu, newe ahaahumburɨra abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi amaheene. Ararwa kwa Bhaabha, na hanʉ akuhika kwa niimwɨ, arabhamenyeekererya amaheene gaanɨ.
Na niimwɨ imwʉsi mʉramenyeekererya amangʼana gaanɨ, kʉ kʉbha mwarɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niinyɨ kwɨma ʉbhʉtangɨ.
